text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

WHEAT SALE - South Korean feed milling companies on Thursday jointly bought 35,000 tonnes of Argentine feed wheat at $143 a tonne C&F, traders said. They said the purchase was made from Daewoo Corp through a private negotiation for April 15-May 15 shipment. Arrival was set to Inchon and Ulsan.
- USDA said private exporters reported sales of 112,000 tonnes of wheat to Israel for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year.

RICE SALE - Iran bought 60,000 tonnes of 100 percent B grade rice from Thailand for May/August shipments, trade sources said on Thursday. The price was quoted at around $330 per tonne FOB Bangkok, they told Reuters.

CORN AND WHEAT TENDER - The Cyprus Grain Commission on Wednesday invited tenders for the supply of an combined shipment of 10,000 tonnes spring and 8,000 tonnes durum wheat, and a shipment of 18,000 tonnes of corn. Shipment for the combined wheat cargo is scheduled at the end of April or the beginning of May, while the corn shipment is scheduled the beginning of May 1997. Both tenders close on April 8.

CORN TENDER - South Korea on Tuesday invited tenders to buy 52,500 tonnes of U.S. yellow No.2 corn. Traders said shipment was set for July 1-20 if sourced from the U.S. Gulf, July 15-August 5 if sourced from the Pacific Northwest, or June 20-July 10 if from Argentina. Arrival was set for Inchon.

BARLEY TENDER - Tunisia on Wednesday launched a tender for Friday for the purchase of four lots of feed barley of 25,000 tonnes each for shipment from September to November, traders said. Shipment dates are Sept 5-15, Oct 1-10, Oct 20-31 and Nov 20-30. The deadline for submitting offers is Friday.
BARLEY TENDERS CONT'D - The South African Wheat Board said it was offering 25,150 tonnes of feed grade barley for export sale no later than April 30.
RICE TENDER - Syria seeks 12,000 tonnes of white rice for shipment between April 20 and May 20. April 8 is the final date for bids and result will be announced on April 16.

LENTIL TENDER - Syria's General Establishment for Cereal Processing and Trade has offered 16,000 tonnes of lentils for export. An international call for prices setting April 8 as final date to receive bids was issued. Confirmation would be made on April 9. The lentils would be ready for May shipment.
VEGOIL TENDER - Algeria is expected to tender for 20,000 tonnes of sunflowerseed oil over the weekend, for May shipment, U.S. exporters said.

MARKET TALK - The South African Wheat Board said on Thursday it had made available 85,045 tonnes of surplus wheat for export to African countries only... More than 400,000 tonnes of wheat bought under Iraq's oil-for-food deal with the United Nations will be in Iraq by mid-April, a U.N. official said.

... The U.S. Agriculture Department said El Salvador has been authorized to buy $6 million worth of soybean meal, $2.8 million worth of vegetable oil and $1.2 million worth of tallow under Public Law 480. USDA said the contracting period is April 9 through September 30 and the delivery period is April 9 through December 31.
